rv.q: Maintaining its freshness and bubbly energy with a recent cast change, the jukebox musical & Juliet looks set to continue wowing it's Prosecco guzzling audiences well into the future.
& JULIET which opened at Theatre on November 20 is certainly fun and enjoyable.

cn.t: This fizzy jukebox musical reworking Shakespeare with Max Martin's pop hits delivers bubbly fun and enjoyment, even if catchy songs don't necessarily make for groundbreaking theatre.
